title: Sufficiently Analyzed Magic
description: A "Skyblock" Modpack. Focused on Hexcasting, Create, and Botania, with some others.
body:
A modpack focusing on Create, Spectrum, Botania, and Hexcasting, with a few others to appease my friends, like NEEPmeat, Spelunkery and Origins. Originally intended to be a skyblock modpack, but since expanded.

Has to be launched with java 21, for some reason. 

### Features
- Petal apothecary recipes for all spectrum overworld plants
- Orechid integration for all mods
- Hex Casting tag fixes, supporting create's saw now
- Charged amethyst production via create new age
- black dye from charcoal
- garden of glass pebble gathering produces hexcasting amethyst dust instead
- Hex staves craftable without charged amethyst
- Heated Mixing recipe for Azurite ore
- Mana infusion recipes for the basic spectrum pigments and gems
- Andesite from blocks of amethyst dust
- amethyst dust can be crafted into spectrum amethyst powder
- Hexal freeze conversion of andesite to calcite to basalt
- Fixed certus milling recipe
- Injects a basic backpack into the bonus chest loot table
